svg.title: Magician eval benchmark history
svg.desc: CI process execution medians in milliseconds. Lower is better. Lines break when environment or fixture changes.
svg.text: Latest: 2026-11-12 | 109 saved samples | recent 90 days | PHP: CLI; OPcache and tracing JIT enabled
Process execution only; compile/link excluded. Shared CI runners have timing noise.
